description: This file defines the SavedSearch class, a PHP class extending SugarBean, used within the SuiteCRM project to manage saved search entities. It includes methods for retrieving, displaying, saving, deleting, and redirecting saved search data, along with handling form interactions and user interface elements.

classes.name: SavedSearch
classes.description: Represents a saved search in SuiteCRM, providing methods for CRUD operations, form rendering, and interaction handling related to saved searches.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates HTML for the saved search form, including search options, order settings, and interface controls.

methods.name: getTemplateGroupChooser
methods.description: Creates and configures a TemplateGroupChooser object for selecting and managing display columns.

methods.name: getSelect
methods.description: Returns HTML for a dropdown/select element of saved searches for a specific module.

methods.name: returnSavedSearch
methods.description: Loads a saved search by ID and redirects to the search results page with appropriate parameters.

methods.name: returnSavedSearchContents
methods.description: Retrieves and unserializes the contents of a saved search by ID.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Marks a saved search as deleted based on ID and redirects to the module page.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current search parameters as a saved search record, handling form data and serialization.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Performs a redirect to the index page with search parameters based on saved search ID.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields like search_module and assigned_user_name based on saved search contents.

methods.name: retrieveSavedSearch
methods.description: Retrieves a saved search record from the database and unserializes its contents.

methods.name: populateRequest
methods.description: Populates the $_REQUEST and $_GET superglobals with data from the saved search contents for display.
